rationale: SNY has gapped up 7.60% on what appears to be a single one-minute candle encompassing the entire session so far, with price sitting exactly at the day's high and ATR of only $0.076 on 5-minute bars — the gap itself dwarfs normal intraday volatility, making stop placement extremely difficult relative to any meaningful reward. The broader market is under pressure (SPY -1.10%, VIXY +3.99%), which creates conflicting signals for chasing a large gap-up, and with only 238K shares traded in a single candle there is insufficient price discovery to assess whether the gap will hold or fade. Risk/reward is unfavorable in either direction at this moment.
